parameters.content:
W10 Reschedule / cancel (4.6 item 8; W28 reschedule Flow; Schedule C/D). Entry: Execute Workflow from W07 (taps Reschedule / Other times / Cancel / Keep it, typed intents, slot picks slot_{ISO}:resched:{booking}) and W12 (broker tapped Rescheduled).
Slots ALWAYS come from the W04 slot engine (sub-workflow 'W04 Slots API', excluding the booking being moved). Booking UI: brands.booking_ui = flow -> reschedule Flow with the current booking pre-filled (automation/flows/reschedule-flow.json, completion goes W28 -> here as a pick); list -> 10-slot list in-window, reschedule_offer template (3 slots on 3 days) outside it.
Move = same appointments row + same Graph event (PATCH), reschedule_count + 1, re-checked against Outlook getSchedule AND our own bookings (buffer) inside one statement; the gist exclusion constraint is the last line of defence. Slot gone -> next 3.
Second reschedule -> flagged (escalations kind other, esc_kind=second_reschedule). Cancel -> Graph DELETE, status cancelled, W09 jobs cancelled, broker told, ONE rebooking offer.
Replacements: none of these events opens one (lead choice / Schedule D); a rebooking after a no-show writes lead_activities 'rebooked_after_no_show' so W13 stops its 48-h clock.
Broker notice: session message if the broker's 24-h window is open, else utility template broker_booking_changed (automation/templates, I-35a; pending Meta review) plus email from howzit@. Logic automation/lib/w10.mjs; tests automation/tests/W10.test.mjs.

**Schedule C1A (default pending NH-42, options a + b; `W10_C1A_MODE` = a | b | a+b | off):** a verified lead who cancels and does not rebook by the end of the rebooking offer + follow-up sequence (96 h) -> W13 `claim` uncontactable / `unreachable` / `cancel_no_rebook`; a plain "I don't want a call" / "No thanks" -> messaging stops at once (op `no_call`), then W13 `claim` disqualified / `nofit_criteria` / `no_call`; a rebook -> nothing claimed. Hourly sweep, one decision row per cancelled booking (`w10:c1a:{booking_id}`). Every send to the lead updates `leads.last_contact_at` (I-38d).

parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.cycle_id, a.appointment_date, a.ends_at, a.method, a.status, a.graph_event_id, a.reschedule_count, a.call_number,
       l.first_name, l.last_name, l.phone, l.email, l.email_status, l.conv_state, l.opted_out_at, l.language, l.stage,
       b.contact_person, b.whatsapp_number, b.email AS broker_email, b.methods_supported, b.calendar_email, b.buffer_minutes, b.slot_minutes,
       br.booking_ui, br.booking_flow_id,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound') AS last_inbound_at,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.broker_id = b.id AND c.lead_id IS NULL AND c.direction = 'inbound' AND c.sender_type = 'broker') AS broker_last_inbound_at
  FROM public.appointments a
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = a.client_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = a.broker_id
  JOIN public.brands br ON br.id = a.brand_id
 WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND (a.id = $1::uuid OR ($1::uuid IS NULL AND a.client_id = $2::uuid))
 ORDER BY a.appointment_date DESC
 LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
WITH chk AS (
  SELECT NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments x
            WHERE x.broker_id = $2::uuid AND x.brand_id IS NOT NULL AND x.status IN ('booked','confirmed') AND x.id <> $1::uuid
              AND tstzrange(x.appointment_date - make_interval(mins => $5::int), x.ends_at + make_interval(mins => $5::int), '[)')
                  && tstzrange($3::timestamptz, $4::timestamptz, '[)')) AS free)
UPDATE public.appointments a
   SET appointment_date = $3::timestamptz, ends_at = $4::timestamptz, reschedule_count = a.reschedule_count + 1,
       status = 'booked', confirmed_at = NULL, updated_at = now()
  FROM chk
 WHERE a.id = $1::uuid AND chk.free AND a.status IN ('booked','confirmed')
RETURNING a.id, a.graph_event_id, a.reschedule_count;

parameters.query:
-- W10 Schedule C1A sweep - DEFAULT PENDING NH-42 (options a + b). Latest booking per lead is cancelled (last 30 days),
-- no C1A decision row yet. Evidence = message log: who cancelled (W10 timeline actor), rebook offered, inbound after cancel.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.client_id) a.id, a.client_id, a.broker_id, a.brand_id, a.cycle_id, a.status, a.cancelled_at, a.created_at
    FROM public.appointments a
   WHERE a.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   ORDER BY a.client_id, a.created_at DESC)
SELECT t.id AS booking_id, t.client_id AS lead_id, t.broker_id, t.brand_id, t.cycle_id, t.status, t.cancelled_at,
       l.verified_at, l.first_message_at, l.opted_out_at, l.conv_state,
       (SELECT x.actor_type FROM public.lead_activities x WHERE x.idempotency_key = 'w10:cancelled:' || t.id::text LIMIT 1) AS cancelled_by,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments a2 WHERE a2.client_id = t.client_id AND a2.id <> t.id AND a2.created_at > t.cancelled_at) AS rebooked,
       COALESCE((l.conv_state->>'rebook_offered')::boolean, false) AS rebook_offered,
       COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('content', q.content))
                   FROM (SELECT c.content FROM public.communications c
                          WHERE c.lead_id = t.client_id AND c.direction = 'inbound' AND c.created_at > t.cancelled_at
                          ORDER BY c.created_at LIMIT 20) q), '[]'::jsonb) AS inbound_after_cancel,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.replacements r WHERE r.lead_id = t.client_id AND r.status <> 'rejected') AS already_claimed
  FROM latest t
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = t.client_id
 WHERE t.status = 'cancelled'
   AND t.cancelled_at > now() - interval '30 days'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_activities y WHERE y.idempotency_key = 'w10:c1a:' || t.id::text);

-- One row per cancelled booking ('w10:c1a:{booking_id}'); the claim goes to W13 only if this insert wins.
INSERT INTO public.lead_activities (lead_id, brand_id, broker_id, cycle_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, 'W10', 'system', $5, $6::jsonb, now(), $7)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
